notes: Reserves the pre-reset source count and evaluates the gameplay tag query against each component’s reflected MinigameTags; skips null components. FGameplayTagQuery::Matches constructs an evaluator and calls Eval(Tags), as in the captured forwarding helper. Captured evaluator parses the query token stream, including empty or invalid stream handling, and checks container tags and parents.
